edges.reason: fallback() forwards execution to _fallback().
receive() forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback calls isContract(msg.sender) to filter ETH transfers from contracts.
Attacker-controlled msg.sender is passed into isContract for contract detection.
isContract performs the extcodesize assembly check.
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook.
_fallback resolves and calls _implementation() to obtain the target address.
_fallback delegates to _delegate with the resolved implementation.
_implementation assigns the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT and sloads it into local slot.
The constant IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is read when resolving the implementation.
_delegate performs the low-level delegatecall to the implementation.
The implementation parameter is the delegatecall target address.
Assembly result variable stores the delegatecall return flag.
_delegate consumes the implementation parameter as its delegatecall destination.
_upgradeTo accepts newImplementation as its upgrade target.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation to persist the new address.
newImplementation flows from _upgradeTo into _setImplementation.
_setImplementation takes newImplementation as an argument.
newImplementation is validated by isContract before being stored.
_setImplementation writes the implementation into storage via assembly sstore.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the storage location written by sstore.
The ifAdmin modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender with the stored admin.
ifAdmin reads the admin via _admin for the authorization check.
Non-admin callers are routed to _fallback by the ifAdmin modifier.
admin() returns the address from _admin under the ifAdmin guard.
implementation() returns _implementation() under the ifAdmin guard.
changeAdmin stores the new admin via _setAdmin.
The newAdmin parameter is consumed by changeAdmin.
The newAdmin parameter flows into _setAdmin.
_setAdmin performs the assembly sstore that overwrites the admin slot.
ADMIN_SLOT is the storage location written by sstore.
upgradeTo calls the internal _upgradeTo under the ifAdmin guard.
The newImplementation parameter is consumed by upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall first upgrades via _upgradeTo under the ifAdmin guard.
The newImplementation parameter is consumed by upgradeToAndCall.
The data parameter is consumed by upgradeToAndCall.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the new implementation with arbitrary data.
newImplementation is the delegatecall target inside upgradeToAndCall.
Admin-supplied data becomes the delegatecall payload.
The success flag captured from delegatecall is checked by upgradeToAndCall.
_admin sloads ADMIN_SLOT into the local adm variable.
_admin reads the ADMIN_SLOT constant.
_willFallback compares the untrusted msg.sender against the admin.
_willFallback calls _admin to perform the caller authorization check.
